model_scope.parameters: hbar>0, chi>0, c>0, g>0, lambda>0, r<0, beta>0
model_scope.onsite: r|q|^2/2 + (g/4) sum_e q_e^4 + (lambda/4) sum_(e~f in E(Q3)) (q_e-q_f)^2(q_e^2+q_f^2)
model_scope.spatial: (c/2) sum over positive-direction spatial bonds |q_y-q_z|^2, giving +3c onsite and ordered coupling Jhat_0=6c
convention_pins: periodic edge multiset has 3V bonds and six endpoint incidences per site
spatial Laplacian eigenvalue is 2 E(p), E(p)=sum_j(1-cos p_j)
finite-grid source uses eta=t sqrt(epsilon) (a_y u)
